title: Red-Light Green-Light Challenge
description: A high-intensity Red Light Green Light game inspired by Squid Game, where movement detection and timed phases create a thrilling survival challenge.
body:
✅ Plugin Description — Red Light Green Light Challenge

Red Light Green Light Challenge brings the iconic “Don’t Move” survival game into a full Beat-the-End Minecraft challenge!

When the light is Green, you’re free to move — gather resources, explore, speedrun the game.
But when it turns Red, you must freeze immediately… or you die on the spot! 😵

The twist?
Even if you die, you’re still in the challenge — the goal is to beat Minecraft while obeying the rules.
Every mistake wastes time… and too many deaths will ruin your chances of finishing before the next Red Light!

Perfect for:
✅ YouTube challenges
✅ SMP competitions
✅ Speedrun-style events
✅ Stream content
✅ Punishing your friends 😈

🎵 Required Resource Pack Included

This plugin comes with a custom texture + sound effects pack that enables:
✔ Start/Stop sound cues
✔ Alert sound for movement during Red Light
✔ UI elements for timing and phases

📌 Make sure ALL players download & enable the included resource pack for the full experience.

🕹 Commands & Permissions
Command	Description	Permission

```
/rlgl start  | Start the challenge    | rlgl.admin
/rlgl stop   | End the challenge	     | rlgl.admin
/rlgl reload | Reload config/settings | rlgl.admin
```



⚙️ Features

✅ Automatic light cycles (configurable timing)

✅ Detects movement during Red Light

✅ Instant kill → keep progressing in the challenge

✅ Boss bar or actionbar phases (configurable)

✅ Works in Survival, Multiplayer, and SMP servers

✅ Fully customizable in config

🔧 Configuration Options (examples)

🟢 Green Light duration (seconds)
🔴 Red Light duration (seconds)
📢 Sound toggle + volume
🎮 Start countdown

📌 Requirements

Minecraft 1.21+

Resource pack included with download

Paper/Spigot server recommended

🎥 YouTube / Content Creator Note

If you make a video using this plugin, please consider crediting my channel:

👉 https://www.youtube.com/@xperrttt

It supports development and future updates — thank you! ❤️
